reconciliation.note: 41 clean pet-friendly and 15 clean verified-no-pets over a 96-identity census. A row publishes only on an OPERATIVE first-party quote from the property's own page, bound to its census identity by the street identity that page states: a fee, a weight, a count, an amenity chip or a service-animal sentence alone publishes nothing. 29 reads were made and did not publish (20 CENSUS_ROW_NOT_ADMITTED; 2 POLICY_NOT_FOUND; 5 QUOTE_NOT_OPERATIVE; 2 SERVICE_ANIMAL_ONLY); every one is named in asheville_nc_clean_authority_001.json with its class. identity_routes.why: release_index.compare is clean over both the expected and the actual release: no cross-market identity collision, no duplicate route, no ownership movement, every live member preserved, every change declared

market_state_pin.why: the pin gains exactly one block whose eight counts equal what the sealed package derives, agrees with the release contract, and every other block is byte-identical

release_integrity.why: no deployment authorization, record, manifest, activation flag, production gate or deployment pin moved; the live parent is verified and the authorized set is unchanged
